title: PWR-A plate-bonded power board, two-sided SHRINK-2 layout (PWR_MAIN + PWR_BRANCH + USB_POWER)
note: W2 PCB-PWRA-4: generated by build/kicad/boards/PWR_A/make_board.py (do not hand-edit; rerun it) from the SHRINK-2 spec PWR_A.spec-shrink2.json and its placement study (W2 PCB-PWRA-3), with the placement changes of make_board.py MOVES, a GND plane via for every SMD GND pad, heights and height zones (hA, PWR-B windows, H-TRIM) and the router budget of a board of record. CI/MODEL only: no fabrication release, bench gates OPEN.

layers.source: W2 PWRJ-LAYERS6: 6 layers JLC06161H-2116 1.6 mm (the stackup of PWR_B and the 6-layer CTRL; pcb/generated/stackup-6l.json from pcb/stackup.py, jlcpcb.com/impedance read 2026-11-12), ordered with finished outer copper 2 oz and inner 0.5 oz (copper_option outer_2oz; jlcpcb.com/impedance, capabilities/pcb-capabilities and 6-layer-pcb read 2026-11-13). 1.6 mm is the order thickness; the contract gives PWR its own stackup (mechanical/generated/contract/boards.json PWR stackup: t 1.664 MODEL with 2 oz outer, order 1.6 +/- 10 %, W2 MECH-8), which the mechanics and the B2B stack row of placement_study use

plan.F.Cu: L1: parts (top), signals; BATT/PWR3A pours (scripted, locked tracks) and power routes at the 2 oz widths
plan.In1.Cu: L2: solid GND plane (pre-route zone, layer type power): every SMD GND pad joins it by its scripted via
plan.In2.Cu: L3: signal routes only (no power class: router.class_layers)
plan.In3.Cu: L4: signal routes only (no power class: router.class_layers)
plan.In4.Cu: L5: GND fill (pre-route plane, layer type power) with the scripted E1_CONV_IN strap/bridge pours of the LM61460 input at higher priority (the L3 role of the 4-layer plan)
plan.B.Cu: L6: bottom chips, signals; BATT/PWR3A pours paired with L1; GND bond copper in the four thermal_bond zones, solder mask on

layers.plan_source: W2 PWRJ-LAYERS6 (build/kicad/boards/PWR_A/make_board.py layers6); the 4-layer plan was build/15 W2 PCB-RULES
layers.types_why: S-G-S-S-P-S as PWR_B and the 6-layer CTRL: In1.Cu (L2) a solid GND plane 0.2234 mm under F.Cu and In4.Cu (L5) the GND fill 0.2234 mm over B.Cu, both of type power so Freerouting routes no trace on them; In2.Cu (L3) and In3.Cu (L4) are the two routing layers the stackup adds, each 0.3 mm from a plane. The power classes stay on the 2 oz outer copper (0.5 oz inner copper would need 1.8 mm for PWR1A and does not count for PWR3A/BATT, netclasses.json). The 4-layer probes routed power on typed-signal inner layers (sr-rx-pcb runs 42424071774, 42424538187), so class_layers keeps them out of In2/In3

rules_note: board_gen refuses rules_file until it copies and hashes it, so the net classes and project rules are mirrored in PWR_A.kicad_pro: classes SIG (Default) 0.15 and the power classes at their 2 oz outer widths of pcb/generated/stackup-6l.json copper_options outer_2oz (PWR1A 0.2, PWR2A 0.4, PWR3A 0.95, BATT 1.6 mm, MODEL), clearance 0.15; router vias 0.7/0.3; min through hole 0.2 because the KiCad LT3045 footprint MSOP-12-1EP ThermalVias drills 0.2 mm (JLC multilayer floor 0.15)

fab_floor.source: https://jlcpcb.com/capabilities/pcb-capabilities read 2026-11-07 (W2 PCB-PWRA-1), multilayer 1 oz values; the same numbers as pcb/generated/netclasses.json fab_floor.jlc_4l_1oz; W2 PWRJ-LAYERS6: 2 oz outer copper, so track and spacing take the 2 oz multilayer floor "Multilayer: 0.15 / 0.15 mm" (jlcpcb.com/capabilities/pcb-capabilities read 2026-11-13)

power_stages.note: W2 PCB-PWRA-3 (design choice; review fixes F1/F2): anchored power stages and their scripted copper. Scripted: E1_SW from J107.2 to Q102; E1_CONV_IN from Q102 to both LM61460 VIN pins (each side with its CIN_HF and CIN, joined by the In2 VIN strap), C107 and both TPSM63606 VIN pins; SYS12 from L102.2 over COUT across the spine to the SYS12 node with F201.1, L202.1 and Q201.2; E1_LAB5_RAW from U108 VOUT to F102.1; E1_LAB5_FUSED from F102.2 to C111.1 and L101.1; LAB5 from L101.2 to C112.1, L205.1 (the LT3045 feed) and the four J208 LAB5 contacts (F.Cu and B.Cu trunk). Left to the router (PCB-PWRA-4; placement_study.py corridor pre-check): the U107/U108 small-signal pins (FB, RT, EN, CBOOT, RBOOT, VCC, BIAS, PG) to their parts, the 0603 E1_CONV_IN bypass C132 at U108, the other LAB5 loads (J104, J206.2, U503, U553, C552, C509, C223, R110), E2_LNA_IN from L205.2 to the LT3045 IN pins and every branch net after F201, L202 and Q201

exemption_policy.why: W2 PWR-L6-SCRIPT (synthesis PWR-L6-SCRIPT, judge 1 power rating): class-width exemptions follow the pad they serve. branch_exempt only for test points, resistors of 100 ohm or more and sense or logic pins; no neck on TVS, connector or harness lands, shunts, fuses, power-switch nodes, eFuse IN/OUT, converter VIN/VOUT/SW pins or converter capacitors; a neck at least as wide as its pad and no longer than it (no pin stems); pin entries are pours whose strip, measured on the zone, is at most half the class width and no narrower than the pad; a branch taps class-width copper, never a power pad. A forbidden role takes an exemption only through a carve-out row below, recorded in build/15 for owner/judge acceptance

carve_outs.why: the TPS259470 RPW0010A IN and OUT are 0.3 x 2.4 mm bars between the signal pin rows, 0.2 mm apart: copper reaches them only at a bar end. TI's own layout (figure 8-22) leaves the IN bar at one end and the OUT bar at the other, at the bar width, into the IN and OUT planes; the entry here is that strip (bar cross-section, at most half the class width long, measured by pcb/check_boards.py) and then a class-width landing. MODEL: a 0.3 x 0.475 mm strip of 2 oz copper is about 0.39 mOhm (6 mW at 4 A); IPC-2221 for long conductors (1.65 A at +10 degC) does not describe a stub between the package bar and the landing; the bench temperature gate stays OPEN. TI also asks for vias under the device into the IN/OUT planes: not taken (0.3 mm bars, project hole-to-hole 0.5 mm), recorded OPEN
carve_outs.source: TI TPS25947xx data sheet SLVSFC9C (rev. C, May 2026) section 8.4.1 Layout Guidelines and figure 8-22 Layout Example, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tps25947.pdf, read 2026-11-14 (curl default User-Agent, HTTP 200, sha256 8f96de389903091650d4f462dcfad3210071c3ae7093623a7978f34baf8a65b4; fetch-only, not committed)

carve_outs.why: LM61460 bootstrap capacitor C127: TI routes the SW connection to CBOOT under the device through the 0.75 mm gap between VIN2 and RBOOT, so this link cannot take the SW class width (BATT 1.6 mm); it carries the gate-drive charge only. Width at least 0.45 mm (the gap less 0.15 mm each side), 0.6 mm outside it, path at most 7 mm, F.Cu only (MODEL; IPC-2221 0.45 mm 2 oz about 2.2 A at +10 degC)

The scripted nets are not autorouted (scripted classes); freeze/plan6.py keeps the zones as F.Cu keep-outs for the other nets, freeze/freeze6.py drops router copper of other nets there; board_audit.py checks it (MODEL)

heights_unread.why: no read or class height in pcb/partition-spec.json heights (harness headers in uncovered edge strips, whose ceilings the contract does not give, and parts not read yet): check_boards lists them unverified (TBD)

heights_lower_bound.why: W2 PWR-L6-SCRIPT review fix RV-PWRL6-PRE-C-04: the height row is a lower bound only (pcb/partition-spec.json lower_bound); board_audit.py counts such a part under a PWR-B THT pin field as an H-TRIM violation

converter_deviations.why: SLVSGB4B 11.1 asks for input-capacitor ground returns on localized top-side planes to the PGND pads; here the GND pads of the 1210 bulk capacitors C130/C131 face away from the module (the E1_CONV_IN bar at y 85 lies between) and return through their own GND vias to the solid In1.Cu plane 0.2234 mm under F.Cu. Accepted because the module integrates dual 0402 input capacitors for the high-frequency bypass (SLVSGB4B 11.1), so the fast input loop closes inside the package; turning the capacitors would put the VIN pads away from VIN1/VIN2. EMI and ripple: bench gate, OPEN

SLVSGB4B 11.1 asks for output-capacitor ground returns on localized top-side planes to the PGND pads; C133-C135 return through the GND bar at y 71.8 and its vias to In1.Cu (0.2234 mm under F.Cu), next to the module, because the VOUT bars to the VOUT pins and their thermal vias fill the space between the capacitors and PGND pad 20. Output ripple and EMI: bench gate, OPEN

scripted_copper_on_board.rule: make_board.py board_copper: F.Cu/B.Cu pours of PWR_A.spec-shrink2.json as locked tracks (ids CU-<pour>); same-net overlapping In2.Cu pours merged

gnd_fanout.rule: make_board.py gnd_fanout (port of PWR_B make_spec.py): stub 0.25 mm from the pad centre to a 0.7 / 0.3 via, or to a GND via within 3 mm

via_in_pad.rule: W2 PWR-A closure round 1, probe Y: a pin that the grid A* completion could not reach otherwise takes a through via in its SMD pad (freeze/freeze6.py --pad-vias; the PWR_B precedent VIP-U215-6/7): 0.6 / 0.3 mm, KiCad clearance 0.15 + 0.01 to every other net on every layer, hole clearance 0.25 + 0.01, 0.5 mm hole to hole (margin_mm: the smallest margin left)
via_in_pad.fab: filled and capped via in pad (POFV), the JLC default from 6 layers; the page gives "via diameters from 0.15 to 0.55 mm" without saying hole or finished diameter (https://jlcpcb.com/capabilities/pcb-capabilities, read 2026-11-13, as PWR_B): TBD at order
via_in_pad.gate: OPEN: assembly gate of the parts with a filled via in a pad (voiding, coplanarity) at the first build
